title: Two Elixir stacks define the same namespaces with divergent implementations
evidence: 28 shared module names between lib/ and tiannara_runtime/lib/; Tiannara.Sentinel 82 vs 89 modules with 3 in common; Tiannara.OED 12 vs 33 with 9 shared; A10 6+6; CIS 4+4
closure_criteria: For every shared module name exactly one implementation exists and is the running one; the other is deleted or reduced to a delegating shim; a test asserts no namespace is defined in two stacks

title: Environmental-awareness subsystem is forked across two stacks
evidence: lib/tiannara/sentinel/ 82 modules; tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara/sentinel/ 89 modules; only 3 names in common; 8 of the S2 modules are empty GenServer shells with capability-claiming docstrings
closure_criteria: One Sentinel survives; it is started by exactly one supervision tree; the empty monitoring modules in the surviving copy are implemented or removed

title: Memory subsystem is fragmented with no single owner
evidence: Tiannara.Memory 8 modules (S1); Tiannara.REA.OrbitMemory 14 (S1); TiannaraRuntime.Memory 1 module (S2); mindcache/ at repo root not integrated
closure_criteria: One memory authority exists with a documented interface; other stacks call it rather than storing knowledge themselves

title: Autonomous research is split across four Elixir namespaces plus Python
evidence: TiannaraRuntime.WorldModel.AutonomousResearch 32; TiannaraRuntime.AutonomousResearch 26; TiannaraRuntime.CausalDiscovery 25; Tiannara.ASC.Research 17; Tiannara.REA.Epistemic 24; Tiannara.Research 16; tiannara_core/research
closure_criteria: One research pipeline owns question formation through report production; other implementations become stages of it

title: Coordination layer exists twice with different vocabularies
evidence: Tiannara.CEL 50 modules (S1); Tiannara.OPC 86 (S2); Tiannara.Meta 6 (S1) and 52 (S2); TiannaraRuntime.CCOS 9; Tiannara.OSE 13
closure_criteria: One coordination vocabulary is authoritative; the other namespace is retired or aliased to it

title: Seven user-facing surfaces with no consolidation decision
evidence: tiannara_observatory/ (965 .ex, 157 .exs, 101 .tsx); tiannara_gui/; tiannara_mobile/; tiannara_saas/; tiannara-desktop/; tiannara_internal_dashboard/; tiannara_pros/; plus Tiannara.Observatory 20 and Tiannara.Interface 10 (S1)
closure_criteria: A written decision names the primary interface and the fate of each other surface; the interface reads from the store the reasoning layer writes to

title: No epistemic-status vocabulary for knowledge or environment
evidence: No owner for observed/inferred/simulated/unknown (spread across OED uncertainty models, Omega verification, DigitalTwin); no owner for established/hypothesis/obsolete (spread across Discovery, CRAV, OED Quarantine.SuspendedTheories, Meta)
closure_criteria: One status taxonomy is defined and adopted by every trace, memory record and environmental datum; AT-C6.1 and AT-C3.2 can be written against it

title: 472 hollow modules with capability-claiming docstrings
evidence: 280 in lib/ (17% of files); 192 in tiannara_runtime/lib/ (15%); detected as @moduledoc >100 chars with public API <= 1
closure_criteria: Each hollow module is either implemented, marked @doc false as internal, or deleted; the count is re-measured and reported per checkpoint

title: Ten empty GenServer shells in the Sentinel monitoring layer
evidence: tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara/sentinel/monitors/ (causal, collapse, ecological, emergence, pressure) and sentinel/baseline/ (anomaly_thresholds, baseline_builder, trend_memory) each contain only use GenServer + init returning {:ok, %{}} under a substantive docstring
closure_criteria: Each monitor computes a real signal and is exercised by a test that asserts a numeric output

title: Runtime-metamorphosis equivalence gate was random and never called
evidence: tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara/phase18/rrm/equivalence_verifier.ex implemented run_with_rules/2 as :rand.uniform(); RuleEvolution aliased the verifier but applied only the drift bound
closure_criteria: Verifier is deterministic, wired into the proposal path, and covered by exact-assertion tests

title: Drift check raised ArithmeticError on any non-numeric rule value
evidence: AdaptationController.compute_drift_delta/2 subtracted values arithmetically; :f32 - :f32 raised ArithmeticError, crashing RuleEvolution.propose_evolution on realistic rule sets
closure_criteria: Value comparison is kind-safe; tests cover numeric and non-numeric rule settings

title: Nine cloned native boundaries each hardcoding a non-existent OTP application
evidence: Application.app_dir(:tiannara_phase{9,10,11,14,15,16,17,18,19}, ...) across tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara/phase*/native_bridge.ex; zero of the 9 applications exist
closure_criteria: One shared config-driven implementation; zero hardcoded application atoms; missing accelerators fail closed with a typed reason

title: Misspelled source root held the sole implementation of seven modules
evidence: tiannara_runtime/lib/tiarnara/phase18/rrm/ defined Tiarnara.Phase18.RRM.* while Tiannara.Phase18.RRM.Supervisor referenced Tiannara.Phase18.RRM.* which did not exist
closure_criteria: Files migrated to lib/tiannara/phase18/rrm/; namespace corrected; no residual Tiarnara module in the repository; supervisor children all resolve

title: Prediction-to-observation-to-update loop does not exist
evidence: Prediction behaviours/ 4 hollow modules; counterfactual behaviours/ 3 hollow modules; autonomous_research behaviours/ 5 hollow modules
closure_criteria: A simulation produces a prediction later compared with an observed outcome; the comparison updates confidence in a replayable way (AT-C4.1, AT-C4.2)

title: No end-to-end cross-domain traversal exists
evidence: 20 canonical domains exist and are bound in lib/tiannara/domains/canonical_registry.ex, but no test traverses more than one domain in a single investigation
closure_criteria: A single investigation traverses >=3 canonical domains and emits a trace with per-domain evidence and conclusion (AT-C1.1)

title: No traceable research report contract
evidence: Research report structures are spread across TiannaraRuntime.WorldModel.AutonomousResearch and Tiannara.ASC.Research; no report artefact contract found
closure_criteria: A report artefact links every claim to a specific evidence record and reproduces identically on replay (AT-C2.3, AT-C2.4)

title: No named arbitration path between conflicting specialists
evidence: Candidates are Tiannara.ASC.Crucible (42 modules), Tiannara.OED.ACM, TiannaraRuntime.Cognitive.Engines (23); no single arbitration contract
closure_criteria: Two specialists with conflicting conclusions are arbitrated by a named process and the outcome is recorded (AT-C5.1)

title: Approved self-change is not routed through constitutional authority
evidence: RRM path proposes and verifies; application of an approved proposal is not routed through Council/CEL; direct Council.authorize/3 callers CEL.Kernel, ResourceManager, ExperimentOrchestrator, Forecasting.DecisionImpl remain disclosed unresolved consumers
closure_criteria: An unauthorised proposal is refused with a typed reason and an authorised proposal carries a valid authority record (AT-C8.2)

title: Interface does not render decision provenance or authority requests
evidence: CP19.20/21/22 produce DecisionReceipt and machine-grant provenance in the MintRegistry; Tiannara.Observatory (20 modules) and Tiannara.Interface (10) have no established binding to it
closure_criteria: For any conclusion the interface shows evidence chain, confidence and approving authority, and lists actionable authority requests (AT-C7.1, AT-C7.2)

title: No approved-source registry for environmental data
evidence: Tiannara.External has 1 module in S1; environmental ingestion appears in tiannara_api/schemas and tiannara_core/data with no shared source authority
closure_criteria: An approved-source registry exists and every environmental datum carries the source that produced it

title: Generated data and phase reports committed to the repository
evidence: tiannara_runtime/data/ holds 26020 files (~300 MB) including 4500+ checkpoints; tiannara_runtime/priv/certification/ holds thousands of phase reports across phase24_9 to phase25_9
closure_criteria: Generated artefacts are excluded from version control and reproducible from source, or are explicitly retained with a retention policy

title: RRM supervisor listed three stateless service modules as children
evidence: Tiannara.Phase18.RRM.Supervisor listed AdaptationController, MetaIRGenerator and Metrics as children; none exports child_spec/1 or start_link/1, so Supervisor.init/2 could not build the child specs and the supervisor could not start
closure_criteria: Supervisor supervises only startable processes; a test asserts every supervised child exports a usable child spec and start_link/1
